Iteration 4 achieved a perfect verifier reward by successfully implementing the Weighted-Risk-Assessment logic and passing all legacy pytest suites.
The execution yielded a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.83 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. The pytest tool (v8.4.1) reported 100% success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite within 0.75 seconds. While the logic is reusable, the discrepancy between verifier and judge rewards suggests potential for further optimization in code style or edge-case handling.
